title: Browser build: pr-ci.yml does not build from latest dev commits.
symptom: The PR CI build outputs version 3.4.2.3-dev instead of the expected 4.0.0-dev-a, even though the PR was intended to merge with the dev branch.
cause: The PR CI workflow merges the PR with its target branch (dev3), not the dev branch, so the version is taken from dev3's Versions.kt, resulting in the older version.
fix: No fix needed; the behavior is correct. The user closed the issue after understanding that the merge target is fixed to the PR's target branch.
evidence_quote: Because PR #4896 will be merged into the dev3 branch, after the merge it will use the Versions.kt from dev3, so the output being version v3 is correct.
